concepts.name: 月霜灵狐
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a polished original fantasy-game companion creature evolution concept sheet, landscape 1536x1024. Primary request: show exactly THREE evolution forms of ONE moon-frost fox spirit, named 月霜灵狐, growing from a battle-capable juvenile to elegant mature and final magical companion, never a giant. Style: exquisitely hand-painted dark fantasy action RPG illustration, fine controlled ink contours, painterly fur, gothic moonlit ruin atmosphere, understated antique gold panel ornaments, consistent with a beautiful Chinese 2D side-scrolling fantasy game. Composition: three full-body 3/4 side views standing on the SAME continuous baseline across left/middle/right, each form fully separate and unobscured; clear evolution arrows and small readable labels "初形", "灵形", "终形"; a gray ADULT HUMAN scale silhouette at far right, same baseline. All three creatures' ear tips and tails remain visibly below human head. Juvenile 35% of adult human height, middle55%, final75% INCLUDING ears/tail aura; final is still a companion-sized quadruped, never taller than the person. Creature identity: silver-white arctic fox, long pointed ears, pale sapphire eyes, midnight-blue paws, one large frosted tail initially, two slim tails intermediate, three graceful crescent-shaped icy tails final, small crescent forehead gem retained across all forms, delicately frosted fur not armor. Baby is agile alert and can lunge, not a doll. Intermediate and final refine the muzzle/legs and icy mane, progressively elaborate small silver/gold crescent collar; aurora wisps and sharp small ice flakes at paws, no large explosion. Color pale white/ice-blue/dark indigo with antique gold accents. Subtle dark navy parchment backdrop with distant ruined arch silhouettes, low contrast so anatomy reads clearly. Top title exactly "月霜灵狐". Bottom small text "终形低于旅者身高". No additional beasts, no copyright characters, no photorealism, no modern cartoon, no watermark, no UI screenshot, no cropped paws or ears. All forms anatomically coherent with four legs.
